description: A gray plastic bin holding clear ice cubes sits on the bed in front, with a yellow cup to the left and a purple tray to the right near the wall. The left hand reaches forward to grasp the yellow cup (left-hand object), lifts it, moves it over the gray bin, then tips it down into the bin to dump the ice before lifting the cup back up; the right hand stays resting near the purple tray without touching anything.
